---
title: Stereo
---

Present different media to the left and right eyes. In the simulator, use
**1** and **2** to inspect the individual eye views. Check the combined result
on a stereo device; a desktop view cannot prove binocular alignment or comfort.

The complete source below shows the per-eye setup and media assets.
